review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, and lead code reviews and design reviews across projects. Lead the complexities of a data engineering project, demonstrating the ability to evaluate solutions and apply the most suitable approach based on trade-offs between performance, cost, maintainability, and time-to-delivery. 3+ years of working experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Expertise in authenticating and authorising
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 3+ years of working experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. Expertise in authenticating and authorising API requests using methods such as OAuth and API keys, and troubleshooting common API-related challenges. Expertise with data modelling tools such as dbt or Dataform. Expertise with cloud data warehousing platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks. Hands-on experience with core cloud data services such as Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, or their AWS equivalents (Lambda, S3, SNS/SQS).
